description: This Java interface defines the service for managing group and center related operations within the Fineract portfolio module, including creation, updating, activation, closure, staff assignment, client association, and disassociation.

classes.name: GroupingTypesWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods for write operations related to groups and centers in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: createCenter
methods.description: Creates a new center based on the given JSON command.

methods.name: updateCenter
methods.description: Updates an existing center identified by entityId with data from the JSON command.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group under the specified center.

methods.name: activateGroupOrCenter
methods.description: Activates a group or center identified by entityId.

methods.name: updateGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing group identified by groupId.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes the group identified by groupId.

methods.name: closeGroup
methods.description: Closes the group identified by groupId.

methods.name: closeCenter
methods.description: Closes the center identified by centerId.

methods.name: unassignGroupOrCenterStaff
methods.description: Removes staff assignments from a group or center.

methods.name: assignGroupOrCenterStaff
methods.description: Assigns staff to a group or center.

methods.name: associateClientsToGroup
methods.description: Associates clients with the specified group.

methods.name: disassociateClientsFromGroup
methods.description: Removes association of clients from the specified group.

methods.name: disassociateGroupsToCenter
methods.description: Removes the association of groups from a center.
